steps.name: A relic awaiting its time (1)
steps.objective: After talking to [Minuet] in “Adrica”, go to [Geas] in the “Burning City”.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Welcome, %s.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I thought you were busy, but see you soon. if… What's going on?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was just passing by and got worried so I came here. Is everything okay?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes, I'm having a good time. It's a little boring, though. I think it would be okay if there was something fun to do.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: No matter where I go, I can't escape this body.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm bored, but I wish there was something fun to do... . I've heard this somewhere before, but did Shinick go there?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I am something that only you can see. Shinik won’t necessarily come to see me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does that mean?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Perhaps Goddess Gaia appeared to Shinik in a different form. Since you can't maintain one look for a long time... .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Instead, he appeared in various forms. Perhaps he appeared in the form of Harmonia, the spirit king of harmony and stability... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, that was it.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Come to think of it, I think Goddess Gaia left a message to the Spirit King of obedience and covenant.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Would you like to go sometime?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… . What's going on? Do you know the minuet?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I don't know anything!

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Still, I told you everything I know. Although the goddess appears incarnate, we do not know everything about the goddess... .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Just in case, I'll let you know if there's anything new to talk about every time you visit. Perhaps Iris there are other things in this world that even the goddess doesn't know about... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's another story that Iris doesn't know about... .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Huh, did I just say that? I remember well... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you're at a disadvantage, are you going to pretend you don't remember? Anyway, it doesn't seem to be right now, so I'll go to Geass like I said before.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes, the Spirit King of obedience and covenant will be waiting.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: I felt some alien force coming into the world of images, and it was you.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: The texture of power changes in such a short period of time... . I must say it is definitely like you. Anyway, I waited.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard that there was a message from Goddess Gaia from Minuet.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Then let's start the story. Do you know the twilight age?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure. Can we think of it as the era of the gods?

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: That's right. It was a time before the appearance of the Demon Lord Beast, a time when many gods coexisted together beyond time and space.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: It was pretty confusing back then too. Many demons lured people into doing things that go against the gods, and the angry gods tried to exterminate the demons.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: But it was canceled because a certain god opposed it. Instead, I was exiled. The exiled demons headed to a place now called the Demon World.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Those demons worshiped and worshiped the 'Twisted One', thinking they were gods, and stole a lot of what could be considered the heritage of the gods.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: In the process, there was a fight between gods, spirits, and demons, and many relics were damaged or their whereabouts remain unknown.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: At least a few were managed safely by righteous humans and elves... .

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: A few others, like the 'Staff of Destruction' and the 'Book of Shadows' that you learned about a long time ago, were tried to be used for evil purposes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what should I do?

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: I'd like you to find out what 'relic' the other-minded being is targeting next.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do I just need to find out?

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: That's right. All you have to do is figure out which relic you need to protect, and the relic will lead you to it when the time comes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. So where should we go first... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Suddenly, a vague image of the Belfa Library and librarians appears in my mind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Library… .

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: That's where you should go. Go where it leads you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, then I will go.

steps.name: A relic awaiting its time (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [Evil Order] in the “Frozen World” and obtain <God’s Artifact Volume 1>. Then report to Fel in the “Belfar Library”.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Welcome… . At that moment, Pell asked me to wait.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow, how did you know... . Ah, Fel is definitely an inspiration.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: I suddenly had a feeling that Adventurer would come. But what's going on?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's look at books related to the Twilight Age and artifacts from that era.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Ah, I see. Then we will find the book for you. There are very few books left about Twilight Age artifacts, so I remember them clearly.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: God's relic... .

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Ah, Liz. That book. Could it be that it was lost some time ago?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lost?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Adventurer, what should I do? Not long ago, someone from the Union of Light borrowed some books from Luman, and there were some related books.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: However, they say that it was lost because some spirit carried it away and flew away. I think it was probably a reaction to the magic left in the book.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: So I looked into the place where the spirit flew, and it turned out to be a place called the Image World. It was also the deepest place in the world of imagination.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, if it’s a ‘frozen world’… .

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: You know that place… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I have been there before.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: We want to go, but it's hard to get in unless you're a special person... .

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Please… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll come back. I guess it's something I need... .

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: If you are looking for a book, please come to us... . Apparently, the spirit reacts, and since it is a book taken by the spirit, it has to go through some kind of purification ritual... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Then I'll come back.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: And… . Huh, you're already gone. I still have something left to say.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Oh, I was going to tell you that there is one more book that was lost due to spirits... .

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: I can't help it. Let's talk when you come back.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: You’re here… . Did you find the book?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I came here. It was a bit difficult this time too.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Adventurer, I'm sorry. What should I do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Is there any problem?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: That's it. Actually, I was going to tell you before you left that there was one more lost book... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh, that's right. For some reason, the book said it was volume 1. That means there are two volumes... . Could it be that the book was lost too?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Yes, that's right... .

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: The spirit that flew away carrying the book also flew away carrying another book due to the magic power remaining in the book.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Haha… , sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's no need for Fel and Liz to feel sorry... . I can't say anything about the spirit's reaction to magic.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: You look quite annoyed... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow, it shows a lot. So where did the spirit go with the book? Did you know?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Of course… no see… .

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Still, I think it's close by. Monster Tree Mountain in the Mirgandia region... .

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: But… . I don't know where Monster Tree Mountain is... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There is someone that comes to mind, but if you get their help, you might be able to find it surprisingly quickly.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: If so, that's a relief.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: … I guess that spirit is an old man.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know him.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: I've never seen it, but I've heard the story. He was there for a long time, watching over the Mirgandia region.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You have a somewhat unusual way of speaking.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: According to the records in the ancient book… .. They say special spirits from ancient times use that special way of speaking… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Reminds me of a spirit with a similar way of speaking….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, then I'll get the book. Is there anything else you want to say before I leave?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: This time I told you everything. If you bring me the books, I will decipher Volumes 1 and 2 right away and let you know.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: … I did it all too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll come back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (By the way, this somehow seems similar to deciphering the Book of Adepts...)

steps.name: A relic awaiting its time (5)
steps.objective: Defeat [Arborum] in “Monster Tree Mountain Valley” and obtain <God’s Artifact Volume 2>. Then go to [Pell] in the “Belfar Library”.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: You are here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Lapidem.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: But what happened? I wonder if something serious will happen when you come.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It is said that a spirit took a book that someone else had borrowed from the Belpa Library and went to Monster Tree Mountain.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It just so happened that it happened like that. And since the book is related to a relic of God... .

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Ah, that was it. Goddess Gaia asked you to find out because we don't know which bad guy will take which artifact in the future.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. So, do you happen to know the whereabouts of the book? I think you know something about Lapidem.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I know, but… , first of all, I’m sorry. It's all because of me... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? What does that mean?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I was a little bored. I asked the little spirits to bring me anything interesting, but they ended up bringing a book that someone else was reading.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: It seems like it was fun for those kids. I could already feel the magic from that book... .

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: But… , I don't have that book.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could it be that that little spirit... .

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: It looks like the spirit brought it back and lost consciousness due to its magical power... . How did the little boy get better? I don't know where the book went... .

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: All I knew was that I had fallen deep into a valley.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It can't be helped. I'll go and find it.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I'm sorry. Instead, I said I will imbue you with the power of the land so that you can find artifacts more easily.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. And don't worry too much about the book. It's not like the spirit did that on purpose... . No, it's not like that!

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Thank you. Oh, then please do that too. After finding the book, I hope you tell the shamans who serve Leda that you are sorry. Got it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. No, I will!

steps.name: A relic awaiting its time (6)
steps.objective: Feel the energy of the relic inside the “Void Sea” and go to [Geas] in the “Burning City”.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Thank you for your hard work.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: If you give me the book, I will proceed with the purification right away… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, the book is here.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Please wait a moment.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: (Liz opens the book, closes her eyes, and chants a spell in a low voice. Then, light appears and disappears from the magic circle created behind Liz.)

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: It's over... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As expected, Fel and Liz are fast.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Fast delivery… . No, because it's quick and accurate.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: I wonder what artifacts are waiting for Adventurer. Please read it quickly. The moment you read it, something will pop into Adventurer’s mind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So, shall we read it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (While reading the book, memories of unknown artifacts flow into my mind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A seed swaying in the wind comes to mind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wind? Seeds? Seed of the wind, something like this?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Fel… . Is there anything that comes to mind after hearing what Adventurer says... ?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Hmm. Seed of the wind, windy seed... . I think I saw it in a book... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Windy Seed? What is that?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: … Maybe that's the artifact Adventurer will encounter... . We don't know where it is or what it does.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: I don't know if I would know if I received it from an oracle.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Anyway… , We'll meet when the time comes... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems like the wind is coming from somewhere... .

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Wind… . The artifact may be calling Adventurer. Follow the direction you feel the wind. I might know something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I should do that. Pell, Liz. thank you.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Thank you for your hard work. Hope to see you again next time.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Goodbye… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then where should I go... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The wind blows from somewhere. It feels like it is leading me into the empty sea.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Is it there?
(Where %s's feet stopped, the wind flow also stopped.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this... ? The wind flow stopped here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems like a road that leads somewhere. But where does it lead... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Zerenis Hill… . Directions to Magic Academy Zerenis?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this the place Jubil mentioned before?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel strange.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why not go now? First, let's go to Geass. You'll understand if we talk about it.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Every time you enter this world, I am amazed. It seems like I had a hard time for a short period of time... , thank you for your hard work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I have been there.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: So have you discovered the artifact that will greet you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I saw seeds swaying in the wind. The librarians at Belfar Library called him ‘Windy Seed’.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: I too have heard the name ‘Seed of the Wind’. However, I don't know what it is used for or what it looks like.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Even though he is the Spirit King, he doesn't know much about what goes on in the outside world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It felt like the wind was blowing from somewhere and guiding me. Since you told me to wait, wouldn't I be able to go someday?

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Yeah. You wait. But what was the name of the place where the wind led you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is the road to Zerenis Hill and Zerenis Magic Academy.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Zelenis... . It is the name of a great wizard.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Since you feel the power of the relic, we will meet when the time is right. But be careful because it can be dangerous.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. See you later, Geass.
